_comment: class -> per-row methodology printed by campaign.py cmd_next (APPROACH/AVOID/REFS). Distilled from skills/workflow/ctf-box. Generic only, never client data. Keys MUST be real board vuln-class tokens.

content-discovery.do: feroxbuster recursive FIRST then the big list; fuzz /~FUZZ userdir early (Apache mod_userdir can host a whole second app); READ every .js / inline <script> / onclick end to end - a JS/SPA API map lives in app.js, not in ferox output.
content-discovery.avoid: grep is not the read; do not conclude 'no hidden route/param' until feroxbuster AND nuclei have both run and been read whole; a labelled or troll file is usually a decoy, don't brute it.

cve-check.do: searchsploit <app> <ver> AND msfconsole search FIRST; prefer the vetted msf module or a copy-paste searchsploit PoC over a hand-rolled exploit.
cve-check.avoid: do not deep-dive a CVE writeup before checking the two quick-win tools; verify the exact version band before firing a version-specific PoC.

sqli.do: in-band UNION/error before blind; test every quote context (' " numeric) and second-order; run sqlmap only AFTER a manual confirm of an injectable param.
sqli.avoid: disprove a param ONCE, log it in Deadends.md, and never re-test or launch sqlmap at an already-disproven param.

xss.do: use a unique marker per injection point; confirm it reflects unencoded in an executable context; stored/blind -> a beacon, not inference.
xss.avoid: no XSS claim from a marker that comes back HTML-encoded or lands in a text-only context.

idor.do: two accounts: prove account A reads account B's object; sample a bounded set of IDs.
idor.avoid: a one-account result cannot tell cross-tenant access from your own data; never claim IDOR with one identity, and never range-sweep IDs.

ssrf.do: OOB-gate it: stand up interactsh/Collaborator and confirm the callback; then cloud metadata (169.254.169.254) and redirect bypasses.
ssrf.avoid: no blind-SSRF claim from inference or a timing guess - silence without a live listener is a false negative, not a result.

upload.do: confirm the app actually USES this upload (is the stored file reachable and executed?) before grinding extension/content-type/magic-byte bypasses.
upload.avoid: an unauth upload that lands outside the webroot with no execution is a dead end - do not spend the box on it.

privesc-auto.do: ALWAYS pspy64 first (watch >=60s for root cron/timers), THEN linpeas (default scan, not -a on a small VM). Capture both: a --term shot AND the full .md log.
privesc-auto.avoid: do not hand-roll find/ls/cat privesc enum instead of linpeas; a root cron hides in the full pspy stream a keyword grep skips.

privesc-manual.do: walk the checklist: sudo -l, SUID/getcap, cron/systemd timers, group memberships (docker/lxd/disk/adm), config+backup creds - and reuse EVERY captured secret across users x su/ssh first.
privesc-manual.avoid: kernel-LPE (PwnKit/DirtyPipe/...) is a LABELLED FALLBACK: verify the intended path is absent AND the CVE precondition holds before firing; don't grind a new vector while an unused cred spray remains.
